	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, business_date_string
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, year_month
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, business_date_string
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, year_month
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0
)

), lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.leg_no
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.parent_security_name
		, ss.abor_security_type_name as parent_security_type_name
		, ss.abor_instrument_type_id as parent_instrument_type_id
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO REFERENCE DATA */
	left join 
		reference.scd_securities ss
			on mhl.business_date = cast( ss.business_date as date )
			and mhl.parent_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name = unitization.pool_name
), lt_clean as (
	select
		  business_date
		, id_model_portfolio
		, pool_name
		, security_name
		, total_market_value_pc
		, bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, parent_quoted_currency_code
		, parent_quoted_currency_name
		, currency_of_exposure_code
		, currency_of_exposure_name
		, case
			when upper(country_of_exposure_name) in ( 'NOT APPLICABLE', 'NOT AVAILABLE', 'DEVELOPED OTHER' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_code in ( 'X0' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_name = 'EUROPE (EX UK)' then 'EU'
			else country_of_exposure_code
		  end country_of_exposure_code
		, case
			when upper(country_of_exposure_name) in ( 'NOT APPLICABLE', 'NOT AVAILABLE', 'DEVELOPED OTHER' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_code in ( 'X0' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_name = 'EUROPE (EX UK)' then 'EUROPEAN UNION'
			else country_of_exposure_name
		  end country_of_exposure_name
		, country_of_exposure_code as country_of_exposure_code_original
		, country_of_exposure_name as country_of_exposure_name_original
		, leg_no
		, parent_security_number
		, parent_security_name
		, parent_security_type_name
		, parent_instrument_type_id
		, investment_structure_level_01
		, investment_structure_level_02
	from
		lt_base
	where
		id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
), lt_lkp as (
	select
		  lt_clean.*
		, case
			when parent_security_type_name in ( 'Medium term debt', 'Internal Term Debt Issuance', 'IRS Interest Rate' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'Securities lending', 'Call money', 'Deposit', 'Cash bucket', 'CD', 'CP' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'FX Forward' ) then 'COUNTRY'
			when leg_no = 2 and parent_security_type_name in ( 'Options-OTC-Credit', 'TRS Equity IC', 'TRS Fixed Income IC', 'Options-OTC-Equity' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when country_of_exposure_code is null and currency_of_exposure_code is null then 'QUOTED CURRENCY'
			when country_of_exposure_code is null then 'CURRENCY'
			else 'COUNTRY'
		  end lkp_typ
		, case
			when parent_security_type_name in ( 'Medium term debt', 'Internal Term Debt Issuance', 'IRS Interest Rate' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'Securities lending', 'Call money', 'Deposit', 'Cash bucket', 'CD', 'CP' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'FX Forward' ) then 'CA'
			when leg_no = 2 and parent_security_type_name in ( 'Options-OTC-Credit', 'TRS Equity IC', 'TRS Fixed Income IC', 'Options-OTC-Equity' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			when country_of_exposure_code is null and currency_of_exposure_code is null then parent_quoted_currency_code
			when country_of_exposure_code is null then currency_of_exposure_code
			else country_of_exposure_code
		  end lkp_value
	from

				, external_reporting_region

), lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.leg_no
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.parent_security_name
		, ss.abor_security_type_name as parent_security_type_name
		, ss.abor_instrument_type_id as parent_instrument_type_id
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO REFERENCE DATA */
	left join 
		reference.scd_securities ss
			on mhl.business_date = cast( ss.business_date as date )
			and mhl.parent_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name = unitization.pool_name
), lt_clean as (
	select
		  business_date
		, id_model_portfolio
		, pool_name
		, security_name
		, total_market_value_pc
		, bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, parent_quoted_currency_code
		, parent_quoted_currency_name
		, currency_of_exposure_code
		, currency_of_exposure_name
		, case
			when upper(country_of_exposure_name) in ( 'NOT APPLICABLE', 'NOT AVAILABLE', 'DEVELOPED OTHER' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_code in ( 'X0' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_name = 'EUROPE (EX UK)' then 'EU'
			else country_of_exposure_code
		  end country_of_exposure_code
		, case
			when upper(country_of_exposure_name) in ( 'NOT APPLICABLE', 'NOT AVAILABLE', 'DEVELOPED OTHER' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_code in ( 'X0' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_name = 'EUROPE (EX UK)' then 'EUROPEAN UNION'
			else country_of_exposure_name
		  end country_of_exposure_name
		, country_of_exposure_code as country_of_exposure_code_original
		, country_of_exposure_name as country_of_exposure_name_original
		, leg_no
		, parent_security_number

		, parent_instrument_type_id
		, investment_structure_level_01
		, investment_structure_level_02
	from
		lt_base
	where
		id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
), lt_lkp as (
	select
		  lt_clean.*
		, case
			when parent_security_type_name in ( 'Medium term debt', 'Internal Term Debt Issuance', 'IRS Interest Rate' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'Securities lending', 'Call money', 'Deposit', 'Cash bucket', 'CD', 'CP' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'FX Forward' ) then 'COUNTRY'
			when leg_no = 2 and parent_security_type_name in ( 'Options-OTC-Credit', 'TRS Equity IC', 'TRS Fixed Income IC', 'Options-OTC-Equity' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when country_of_exposure_code is null and currency_of_exposure_code is null then 'QUOTED CURRENCY'
			when country_of_exposure_code is null then 'CURRENCY'
			else 'COUNTRY'
		  end lkp_typ
		, case
			when parent_security_type_name in ( 'Medium term debt', 'Internal Term Debt Issuance', 'IRS Interest Rate' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'Securities lending', 'Call money', 'Deposit', 'Cash bucket', 'CD', 'CP' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'FX Forward' ) then 'CA'
			when leg_no = 2 and parent_security_type_name in ( 'Options-OTC-Credit', 'TRS Equity IC', 'TRS Fixed Income IC', 'Options-OTC-Equity' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			when country_of_exposure_code is null and currency_of_exposure_code is null then parent_quoted_currency_code
			when country_of_exposure_code is null then currency_of_exposure_code
			else country_of_exposure_code
		  end lkp_value
	from 
		lt_clean
), lt_map as (
	select
		  lt_lkp.*
		, mapping.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mapping.external_reporting_region
		, regexp_replace( coalesce( mapping.external_reporting_country, mapping.lkp_nme ), '(\w)(\w*)', x -> upper(x[1]) || lower(x[2])) as external_reporting_country
	from
		lt_lkp
	left join
		mapping
			on lt_lkp.lkp_value = mapping.lkp_value
), lt_final as (
	select
		  lt_map.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'China', 'Hong Kong', 'Taiwan', 'Macao' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'India' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case
			when currency_of_exposure_code in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
	from
		lt_map
), lt_final_agg as (
	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country

			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region

		from (

				  business_date

), lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.leg_no
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.parent_security_name
		, ss.abor_security_type_name as parent_security_type_name
		, ss.abor_instrument_type_id as parent_instrument_type_id
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO REFERENCE DATA */
	left join 
		reference.scd_securities ss
			on mhl.business_date = cast( ss.business_date as date )
			and mhl.parent_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name = unitization.pool_name

		, currency_of_exposure_name
		, case
			when upper(country_of_exposure_name) in ( 'NOT APPLICABLE', 'NOT AVAILABLE', 'DEVELOPED OTHER' ) then null

			when country_of_exposure_name = 'EUROPE (EX UK)' then 'EU'
			else country_of_exposure_code

		, case
			when upper(country_of_exposure_name) in ( 'NOT APPLICABLE', 'NOT AVAILABLE', 'DEVELOPED OTHER' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_code in ( 'X0' ) then null

			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'FX Forward' ) then 'COUNTRY'
			when leg_no = 2 and parent_security_type_name in ( 'Options-OTC-Credit', 'TRS Equity IC', 'TRS Fixed Income IC', 'Options-OTC-Equity' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when country_of_exposure_code is null and currency_of_exposure_code is null then 'QUOTED CURRENCY'

			when parent_security_type_name in ( 'Medium term debt', 'Internal Term Debt Issuance', 'IRS Interest Rate' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'Securities lending', 'Call money', 'Deposit', 'Cash bucket', 'CD', 'CP' ) then currency_of_exposure_code

	from

	select

		, case

			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
	from
		lt_map
), lt_final_agg as (
	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date

			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date

				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country

			from

			group by 
				  business_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, business_date_string
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, year_month

	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.leg_no
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.parent_security_name
		, ss.abor_security_type_name as parent_security_type_name
		, ss.abor_instrument_type_id as parent_instrument_type_id
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO REFERENCE DATA */
	left join 
		reference.scd_securities ss
			on mhl.business_date = cast( ss.business_date as date )
			and mhl.parent_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name = unitization.pool_name

		, case

		, case

			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'Securities lending', 'Call money', 'Deposit', 'Cash bucket', 'CD', 'CP' ) then currency_of_exposure_code

			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
	from
		lt_map

				, external_reporting_region

				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, business_date_string

				, external_reporting_currency

), lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.leg_no
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.parent_security_name
		, ss.abor_security_type_name as parent_security_type_name
		, ss.abor_instrument_type_id as parent_instrument_type_id
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO REFERENCE DATA */
	left join 
		reference.scd_securities ss
			on mhl.business_date = cast( ss.business_date as date )
			and mhl.parent_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name = unitization.pool_name

), lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.leg_no
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.parent_security_name
		, ss.abor_security_type_name as parent_security_type_name
		, ss.abor_instrument_type_id as parent_instrument_type_id
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO REFERENCE DATA */
	left join 
		reference.scd_securities ss
			on mhl.business_date = cast( ss.business_date as date )
			and mhl.parent_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name = unitization.pool_name

			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'Securities lending', 'Call money', 'Deposit', 'Cash bucket', 'CD', 'CP' ) then currency_of_exposure_code

	from

		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string

				, external_reporting_region

				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc

				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, business_date_string
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, year_month

), lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.leg_no
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.parent_security_name
		, ss.abor_security_type_name as parent_security_type_name
		, ss.abor_instrument_type_id as parent_instrument_type_id
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO REFERENCE DATA */
	left join 
		reference.scd_securities ss
			on mhl.business_date = cast( ss.business_date as date )
			and mhl.parent_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1

		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name = unitization.pool_name
), lt_clean as (
	select
		  business_date
		, id_model_portfolio
		, pool_name
		, security_name
		, total_market_value_pc
		, bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, parent_quoted_currency_code
		, parent_quoted_currency_name
		, currency_of_exposure_code
		, currency_of_exposure_name
		, case

			when country_of_exposure_code in ( 'X0' ) then null

		  lt_clean.*
		, case
			when parent_security_type_name in ( 'Medium term debt', 'Internal Term Debt Issuance', 'IRS Interest Rate' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'Securities lending', 'Call money', 'Deposit', 'Cash bucket', 'CD', 'CP' ) then 'CURRENCY'

			when leg_no = 2 and parent_security_type_name in ( 'Options-OTC-Credit', 'TRS Equity IC', 'TRS Fixed Income IC', 'Options-OTC-Equity' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when country_of_exposure_code is null and currency_of_exposure_code is null then 'QUOTED CURRENCY'

			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'Securities lending', 'Call money', 'Deposit', 'Cash bucket', 'CD', 'CP' ) then currency_of_exposure_code

		, mapping.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mapping.external_reporting_region
		, regexp_replace( coalesce( mapping.external_reporting_country, mapping.lkp_nme ), '(\w)(\w*)', x -> upper(x[1]) || lower(x[2])) as external_reporting_country
	from

		mapping

	select
		  lt_map.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'China', 'Hong Kong', 'Taiwan', 'Macao' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'India' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region

		, case
			when currency_of_exposure_code in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
	from
		lt_map
), lt_final_agg as (
	select *
	from (
		select

			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01

			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (

				  business_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, business_date_string
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, year_month
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, business_date_string
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, year_month
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0
)

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 20
		AND hour between 00 and 01
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-20 00:16:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

with old_breached_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        max(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'N'
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
new_breached_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        min(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'Y'
        and limit_id not in (
            select limit_id
            from old_breached_records
        )
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
first_breach_date as (
    select *
    from old_breached_records
    union all
    select *
    from new_breached_records
),
old_alert_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        max(business_date) first_alert_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_alert = 'N'
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
new_alert_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        min(business_date) first_alert_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_alert = 'Y'
        and limit_id not in (
            select limit_id
            from old_alert_records
        )
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
first_alert_date as (
    select *
    from old_alert_records
    union all
    select *
    from new_alert_records
)
SELECT a.*,
    b.first_breach_date,
    c.first_alert_date,
    date_diff(
        'day',
        cast(b.first_breach_date as date),
        cast(a.business_date as date)
    ) num_of_breach_days,
    date_diff(
        'day',
        cast(c.first_alert_date as date),
        cast(a.business_date as date)
    ) num_of_alert_days
FROM "risk_prod"."limit_utilization" a
    left outer join first_breach_date b on a.limit_name = b.limit_name
    and a.limit_id = b.limit_id
    left outer join first_alert_date c on a.limit_name = c.limit_name

/* cppi::ce2add19ab3f7321a3570dfa6e3baaa86ff6756ae1e44e9b40c2d0ae22cd51f3 */
WITH analytic_pv AS
    (select sd.business_date, analytic_value
     from radar_reporting_dev
    .fact_analytic_sd sd
    join radar_reporting_dev.dim_hierarchy_node dh
on sd.dim_hierarchy_node_id = dh.dim_hierarchy_node_id and dh.node_level=2 and dh.node_name ='BCPP'
    and sd.business_date = dh.business_date
where analytic_type = 'PV'
  and portfolio_type = 'TOTAL_FUND_BY_ACCOUNT'
  and sd.business_date = '2025-06-16'
    )
select ule.gics_sector,
       sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure)                                      as credit_exposure,
       pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit) as conc_sector_limit,
       case
           when max(ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit) > 0 then round(sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) /
                                                                     (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit)) *
                                                                     100, 2)
           else 0 end as usage,
    CASE
        WHEN sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit)) BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.949999999
            THEN 'Yellow Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit)) BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.999999999
            THEN 'Orange Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) >= (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit))
            THEN 'Breach'
        ELSE 'OK'
END
AS status

from radar_reporting_dev.fact_cr_exposure f
         join radar_reporting_dev.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity le on f.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = le.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and f.business_date = le.business_date
         join radar_reporting_dev.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity ule on le.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = ule.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and ule.gics_sector='Financials' and f.business_date = ule.business_date
         --and ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit is not null
		 -- and ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit != -1

         left join analytic_pv pv on f.business_date = pv.business_date
where f.bcpp_credit_exposure is not null
  and f.business_date = '2025-06-16'
group by ule.gics_sector, pv.analytic_value
order by sum(bcpp_credit_exposure) desc

    from asset.enterprise_security ss  
    join holdings.scd_holdings_main shm on shm.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number and cast(ss.business_date as varchar) = shm.business_date

    and ss.bloomberg_cd is not null

                                                    shm.balance_nominal_number_unsettled = 0

			    date,
			    MAX(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (

						ORDER BY date

					date - LAG(date, 3) OVER(
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date

						SELECT erc.data_date AS date,
								erc.currency AS currencyCode,
								erc.exchange_rate AS currencyToCadRate,
								erd.exchange_rate AS currencyToUsdRate,
								erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag as holiday_flag

         sec.abor_security_group_name as instrument_sub_group_name,
         ss.abor_security_type_id as instrument_type_code,
         ss.abor_security_type_name as instrument_type_name,
         ss.abor_security_name as instrument_name_source,
         ss.balance_nominal_number as current_nominal,
         ss.balance_nominal_number * ss.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as current_nominal_pc,
         ss.accrued_interest_end_of_period_portfolio_currency as abacus_accrued_interest_pc,
         ss.accrued_interest_end_of_period_quotation_currency as abacus_accrued_interest_qc,
         ss.quotation_currency_code as current_notional_currency,
         ss.quotation_currency_code as market_value_currency,
         ss.clean_value_quotation_currency as clean_market_value,
         ss.clean_value_quotation_currency as book_value,
         ss.clean_value_quotation_currency as cost_value,

         ss.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as fx_rate_quoted_in_cad,
         ss.clean_value_portfolio_currency as clean_market_value_pc,
         ss.balance_book_value_portfolio_currency as cost_value_pc,
         ss.accrued_interest_end_of_period_portfolio_currency as current_accrued_amount_pc,
         sec.abor_quote_factor as quote_factor,
         sec.abor_quote_type as quote_type_description,
         ss.exposure_portfolio_currency as exposure_pc,
         ss.clean_price as current_clean_price,
         '2025-06-19' as business_date,
         ss.quotation_currency_code as quoted_currency_code
		 from holdings.scd_holdings_main ss
		 left join RankedSecurities sec
			on ss.scd_security_id = sec.scd_security_key_id
		 where sec.abor_security_group_id = 'CD'
		   and ss.clean_value_quotation_currency != 0
		   and ss.business_date = '2025-06-19'
         ) as a
    left Join
         (select
          CAST(cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_sec_id_new,
          document_type,
          instrument_description,
          cusip ,
          isin,
          sedol,
          ticker,
          issue_date ,
          bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange ,
          bloomberg_unique_id ,
          coupon_rate ,
          coupon_type ,
          coupon_frequency_code,
          maturity_date,
          country_code as mds_country_code,
          exchange_name,
          region_code,
          market_sector_description,
          issue_country_iso,
          callable_flag,
          next_coupon_date,
          first_coupon_date,
          issue_date,
          par_amount,
          exchange_name,
          bloomberg_exchange,
          next_call_date,
          mic,
          issue_price,
          delete_date,
          cast(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_party_id_new
          from asset.asset_money_market
          where business_date = date'2025-06-19'
         ) as b
     on a.id_instrument_new=b.cppib_sec_id_new   
    left join
         (select
          CAST(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_party_id_new3,
          party_name, 
          bloomberg_company_id, 
          domicile_country_code,
          incorp_country_code
          from party.party
          where business_date = date'2025-06-19'
         ) as d
     on b.cppib_party_id_new=d.cppib_party_id_new3
    left join
         (select
          CAST(cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_sec_id_new3,
          cppib_country_of_exposure_code ,
          cppib_currency_code ,
          cppib_currency_of_exposure_code
          -- cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
          -- cppib_sector_classification_name_2,
          -- cppib_sector_classification_name_3,
          -- cppib_sector_classification_name_4
          from asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications
          where business_date = date'2025-06-19'
         ) as e
     on b.cppib_sec_id_new=e.cppib_sec_id_new3
    left join
         (select
          country_code,
          country_name
          from reference.reference_country_codes
          where business_date = date'2025-06-19'
         ) as f
     on e.cppib_country_of_exposure_code=f.country_code
    left join
         (select
          currency_code,
          currency_name
          from reference.reference_currency_codes
          where business_date = date'2025-06-19'
         ) as g
     on e.cppib_currency_of_exposure_code=g.currency_code
    left join
         (select 
     model_portfolio_key,
     id_model_portfolio, 
     unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
     from finance_accounting.model_portfolios
     where business_date = date'2025-06-19'
          ) as h
     on a.id_model_portfolio = h.id_model_portfolio
     left join
          (
               select rating_agency,rating_value,rating_type,rating_date,CAST(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_party_id_new4
               from radar_reporting_prod.cppib_party_rating
               where cast(business_date as date) = date'2025-06-19'
               and rating_agency = 'CPPIB'
          ) as i
     on d.cppib_party_id_new3 = i.cppib_party_id_new4
     left join
          (select
           CAST(cppib_party_id AS int) as party_cppib_party_id,
           cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
           cppib_sector_classification_name_2,
           cppib_sector_classification_name_3,
           cppib_sector_classification_name_4,
           cppib_country_of_exposure_code as party_cppib_country_of_exposure_code
          from party.party_enterprise_classification
          where business_date = date'2025-06-19'
          )  as pr
     on pr.party_cppib_party_id = cast(b.cppib_party_id_new AS int)

            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) / isrc_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
        WHEN b.status = 'BREACH'
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit

            OR SUM(der_exp) >= der_smd_threshold

            THEN 'EXCESS'

    SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS repo_sbl_exp,

    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((repo_sbl_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(repo_sbl_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS repo_sbl_available,
    CASE

    CASE
        WHEN der_smd_threshold = 0 OR der_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0

    COALESCE(total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit / 1000000, 0) AS total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,

    CASE
        WHEN smd_total_limit = 0 OR smd_total_limit IS NULL THEN 0

    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((smd_total_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(smd_total_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS smd_total_available,

	ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,

    CASE WHEN SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isrc_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS smd_limit_blown

FROM curr_exp_total c

            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499

            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) / isrc_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999

            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'

            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit

    CASE

    SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS repo_sbl_exp,

    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((repo_sbl_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(repo_sbl_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS repo_sbl_available,
    CASE

    CASE
        WHEN der_smd_threshold = 0 OR der_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0

    COALESCE(total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit / 1000000, 0) AS total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,

    CASE
        WHEN total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit = 0 OR total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp)) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit * 100

    SUM(smd_total_exp) / 1000000 AS smd_total_exp,

    CASE
        WHEN smd_total_limit = 0 OR smd_total_limit IS NULL THEN 0

FROM curr_exp_total c

                                      )
                                 THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS isrc_total_exp,
                 MAX(child.isrc_total_fi_limit) AS isrc_total_limit,
                 SUM(
                         CASE

                                          OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )

                     ) AS smd_total_exp,

             FROM

                 radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent,
                 radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,
                 radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos

                 and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
                 and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
                 AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                 AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                 AND fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
                 AND UPPER(pos.product_type) <> 'NETTING'
                 AND
                 (
                         parent.is_fi = 'Y'

                                     SELECT 1

                                     WHERE
									   parent.business_date = sibling.business_date

                                       AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                                       AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'

                             END AS status
                     FROM child_level_exp_limits

SELECT
    'Y' AS has_children,
    c.party_name,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) / isrc_total_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) / isrc_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
        WHEN b.status = 'BREACH'
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit
            THEN 'BREACH'
        WHEN b.status = 'EXCESS'
            OR SUM(der_exp) >= der_smd_threshold
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold
            THEN 'EXCESS'
        ELSE 'OK'
        END AS status,
    CASE
        WHEN country_code = 'United States' THEN 'US'
        WHEN country_code = 'United Kingdom' THEN 'UK'
        ELSE country_code

    CASE
        WHEN total_cash_pb_smd_limit = 0 OR total_cash_pb_smd_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(total_cash_pb_exp)) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit * 100
        END AS cash_pb_util,

    SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS repo_sbl_exp,
    COALESCE(repo_sbl_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS repo_sbl_smd_threshold,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((repo_sbl_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(repo_sbl_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS repo_sbl_available,
    CASE
        WHEN repo_sbl_smd_threshold = 0 OR repo_sbl_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(repo_sbl_exp)) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold * 100
        END AS repo_sbl_util,

    SUM(der_exp) / 1000000 AS der_exp,
    COALESCE(der_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0 ) AS der_smd_threshold,
    CASE
        WHEN der_smd_threshold = 0 OR der_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(der_exp)) / der_smd_threshold * 100
        END AS der_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((der_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(der_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS der_available,

    SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS total_der_repo_sbl_exp,
    COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) - SUM(prev_total_der_repo_sbl_exp)) / 1000000)), '-')  AS repo_der_change_exp,
    COALESCE(total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit / 1000000, 0) AS total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS total_der_repo_sbl_available,
    CASE
        WHEN total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit = 0 OR total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp)) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit * 100
        END AS repo_der_util,

    CASE
        WHEN isrc_total_limit = 0 OR isrc_total_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(isrc_total_exp)) / isrc_total_limit * 100

    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((isrc_total_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(isrc_total_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS isrc_total_available,

    SUM(smd_total_exp) / 1000000 AS smd_total_exp,
    COALESCE(smd_total_limit / 1000000, 0) AS smd_total_limit,
    CASE
        WHEN smd_total_limit = 0 OR smd_total_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(smd_total_exp)) / smd_total_limit * 100
        END AS smd_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((smd_total_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(smd_total_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS smd_total_available,

    SUM(total_exp) / 1000000 AS total_exp,

    MAX(p.prev_rtg_final) AS prev_rtg_final,
    dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
    CASE WHEN SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cash_pb_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(repo_sbl_exp) >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS repo_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(der_exp) >= der_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS der_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS repo_der_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isrc_limit_blown,

                                    AND UPPER(pos.PRODUCT_TYPE) <> 'NETTING'
             WHERE

                 OR EXISTS
                 (
                     SELECT 1
                     FROM radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
                     WHERE
					   parent.business_date = sibling.business_date

                       AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                       AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
                 )
             GROUP BY
                 child.cppib_party_id,
                 child.party_name,
                 child.rtg_final
         ),
     child_level_exp_limits AS
         (
             SELECT
                 parent.cppib_party_id AS cppib_party_id_parent,

                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                 THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END

                             WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category = 'REPOS' AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END

                             WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category = 'DERIVATIVES' AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS der_exp,
                 MAX(child.der_fi_limit) AS der_smd_threshold,

                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS total_der_repo_sbl_exp,
                 MAX(child.der_repo_fi_limit) AS total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                                  (
                                          EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                          OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 OR
                                  (
                                      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS isrc_total_exp,
                 MAX(child.isrc_total_fi_limit) AS isrc_total_limit,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                                  (
                                          EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                                          OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                                      )
                                 OR
                                  (
                                      EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ( 'DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                                      )
                                 THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS smd_total_exp,
                 MAX(child.smd_total_fi_limit) AS smd_total_limit
             FROM
                 radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact,                 
                 radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent,
                 radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,
                 radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
             WHERE
                 fact.business_date = '2025-05-30' 
				 and fact.business_date = child.business_date
                 and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
                 and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
                 AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                 AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                 AND fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
                 AND UPPER(pos.product_type) <> 'NETTING'
                 AND
                 (
                         parent.is_fi = 'Y'
                         OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
                         OR EXISTS
                                 (
                                     SELECT 1
                                     FROM radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
                                     WHERE
									   parent.business_date = sibling.business_date 
                                       and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                                       AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                                       AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
                                 )
                     )               
               AND child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id != child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
             GROUP BY
                 parent.cppib_party_id,
                 child.cppib_party_id
         ),
     breaches_under_parents AS
         (
             SELECT
                 cppib_party_id,
                 MIN(status) AS status
             FROM
                 (
                     SELECT
                         cppib_party_id_parent AS cppib_party_id,
                         CASE
                             WHEN total_cash_pb_exp >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit OR total_der_repo_sbl_exp >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit OR isrc_total_exp >= isrc_total_limit OR smd_total_exp >= smd_total_limit THEN 'BREACH'
                             WHEN der_exp >= der_smd_threshold OR repo_sbl_exp >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
                             ELSE 'OK'
                             END AS status
                     FROM child_level_exp_limits
                 ) p
             GROUP BY cppib_party_id
         )
SELECT
    'Y' AS has_children,
    c.party_name,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) / isrc_total_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) / isrc_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
        WHEN b.status = 'BREACH'
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit
            THEN 'BREACH'
        WHEN b.status = 'EXCESS'
            OR SUM(der_exp) >= der_smd_threshold
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold
            THEN 'EXCESS'
        ELSE 'OK'
        END AS status,
    CASE
        WHEN country_code = 'United States' THEN 'US'
        WHEN country_code = 'United Kingdom' THEN 'UK'
        ELSE country_code
        END AS country_code,
    COALESCE(rtg_final, '-') AS rtg_final,
    COALESCE(rtg_outlook, '-') AS rtg_outlook,

    SUM(cash_exp) / 1000000 AS cash_exp,
    SUM(bonds_mm_exp) / 1000000 AS bonds_mm_exp,
    SUM(pb_exp) / 1000000 AS pb_exp,
    SUM(other_exp) / 1000000 AS other_exp,
    SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / 1000000 AS total_cash_pb_exp,
    (SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) - SUM(prev_total_cash_pb_exp)) / 1000000 AS cash_pb_change_exp,
    COALESCE(total_cash_pb_smd_limit / 1000000, 0) AS total_cash_pb_smd_limit,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((total_cash_pb_smd_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(total_cash_pb_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS total_cash_pb_available,
    CASE
        WHEN total_cash_pb_smd_limit = 0 OR total_cash_pb_smd_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(total_cash_pb_exp)) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit * 100
        END AS cash_pb_util,

    SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS repo_sbl_exp,
    COALESCE(repo_sbl_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS repo_sbl_smd_threshold,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((repo_sbl_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(repo_sbl_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS repo_sbl_available,
    CASE
        WHEN repo_sbl_smd_threshold = 0 OR repo_sbl_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(repo_sbl_exp)) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold * 100
        END AS repo_sbl_util,

    SUM(der_exp) / 1000000 AS der_exp,
    COALESCE(der_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0 ) AS der_smd_threshold,
    CASE
        WHEN der_smd_threshold = 0 OR der_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(der_exp)) / der_smd_threshold * 100
        END AS der_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((der_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(der_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS der_available,

    SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS total_der_repo_sbl_exp,
    COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) - SUM(prev_total_der_repo_sbl_exp)) / 1000000)), '-')  AS repo_der_change_exp,
    COALESCE(total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit / 1000000, 0) AS total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS total_der_repo_sbl_available,
    CASE
        WHEN total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit = 0 OR total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp)) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit * 100
        END AS repo_der_util,

    SUM(isrc_total_exp) / 1000000 AS isrc_total_exp,
    COALESCE(isrc_total_limit / 1000000, 0) AS isrc_total_limit,
    CASE
        WHEN isrc_total_limit = 0 OR isrc_total_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(isrc_total_exp)) / isrc_total_limit * 100
        END AS isrc_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((isrc_total_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(isrc_total_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS isrc_total_available,

    SUM(smd_total_exp) / 1000000 AS smd_total_exp,
    COALESCE(smd_total_limit / 1000000, 0) AS smd_total_limit,
    CASE
        WHEN smd_total_limit = 0 OR smd_total_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(smd_total_exp)) / smd_total_limit * 100
        END AS smd_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((smd_total_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(smd_total_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS smd_total_available,

    SUM(total_exp) / 1000000 AS total_exp,

    MAX(p.prev_rtg_final) AS prev_rtg_final,
    dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
    CASE WHEN SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cash_pb_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(repo_sbl_exp) >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS repo_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(der_exp) >= der_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS der_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS repo_der_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isrc_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS smd_limit_blown

FROM curr_exp_total c
         LEFT JOIN breaches_under_parents b ON c.cppib_party_id = b.cppib_party_id AND 'child' = 'parent'
         LEFT JOIN prev_exp_total p
                   ON c.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id
                       OR c.party_name = p.party_name
GROUP BY
    total_cash_pb_smd_limit,
    repo_sbl_smd_threshold,
    der_smd_threshold,
    total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,
    dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
    c.party_name,
    country_code,
    rtg_final,
    rtg_outlook,
    isrc_total_limit,
    smd_total_limit,
    b.status
ORDER BY

        WHEN status = 'ORANGE ALERT' THEN 2
        WHEN status = 'BREACH' THEN 3
        WHEN status = 'EXCESS' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
        END,
    total_exp DESC,
    c.party_name
